title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, merge all overlapping intervals, and return an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input.

hints.content: Sort the intervals by their start time.
Iterate through: if current interval overlaps with last merged, merge them.
Overlaps when current.start <= lastMerged.end. Merged end is max(lastMerged.end, current.end).

solution.explanation:
Sort intervals by start time, then merge overlapping adjacent pairs.
Time Complexity: O(n log n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
